data.description: HC-0 finding, 2026-09-27, the client's ruling during the first deployed drive: "remove any text that is absolutely unnecessary. no need to narrate the demo. intuitive workflow rather than guided." Named instance: the buzzer's reveal line *The host is reading out the why now.* (copy.js buzzer_reveal_host_reading and buzzer_noanswer_reveal; SPEC §11 buzzer-reveal rows; §5 phase table; prototype line 776). Scope: (1) remove that sentence everywhere it appears; (2) sweep every buzzer, wall and host string in web/shared/copy.js for narration of what someone else is doing or what will happen next, and propose the list of removals in the plan for the client's yes before touching them; keep every line that carries state the reader needs (the count, ✓ It was Y, You didn't answer, the room code, the join address); (3) amend SPEC §11 and the §5 phase table and the prototype in the same PR under the client's ruling, so the copy contract and the build stay one thing; (4) update the string tests. Colour is never the only signal; never let a removed line take a state signal with it. PR against main, fast-track, one Sonnet code review. Dispatch waits until the client's HC-0 drive ends so further findings can join this ticket.

If a criterion cites the line as the anonymity promise's visible form, keep the promise honoured in behaviour and note the amendment in the PR body; the client has ruled the text off.

HC-0 finding 3 (client, 2026-09-27 11:2x), the host phone before the question. The client pasted the screen's text — the phase label "before the question" (host_phase_idle, SPEC §11 line 635, AC-49) and the two not-a-guarantee sentences (not_a_guarantee_options_public, not_a_guarantee_host_honest; SPEC §11 near line 542 says they are shown verbatim) — and ruled: "make this easy to read for a human, title is Pop Quiz Host". Read it as: (1) the host page's title (its <title> and any on-screen heading) becomes "Pop Quiz Host"; (2) the two not-a-guarantee sentences are rewritten for a human reading a phone at the front of a room — short, plain, one idea per sentence, no em-dash, no semicolon-joined clauses — keeping their two facts (the correct answer is always one of the five visible options; the host is not shown it to keep the host honest, not as a security guarantee). This is the one place this ticket writes new copy: propose the rewrite in your plan and in the tab with the removal list, and land it under the same ruled exception (copy.js, host surface, test, §11 and the §8/§9 paragraph that quotes them verbatim, the prototype if it renders them). (3) The phase label itself may stay if it reads as state; if the screen's label plus the sentences feel like narration together, propose the cut in the list.
